fasi.d: In this first stage we get to grips with your needs and goals. We look at the type of project and work closely with you to understand exactly what you want to achieve from the graphics on your vehicle in Bellinzona.

faq.domanda: How much does it cost to wrap a vehicle in Bellinzona?
faq.risposta: The cost depends on the size of the vehicle, the type of graphics (partial or full) and the materials chosen. A fully wrapped van has a different price from simple lettering on the doors. Get in touch for a free, tailored quote within 24/48h.

faq.domanda: Do I need to bring you the vehicle, or do you come to Bellinzona?
faq.risposta: As a rule, the application takes place in our workshop, where we have the equipment and the ideal conditions for a perfect result. We serve all of Bellinzona, the Bellinzona area and the rest of Ticino, and we can arrange collection and return together to suit your needs.

faq.domanda: How long does wrapping a vehicle take?
faq.risposta: From 1 to 6 working days, depending on the complexity of the project and the surface to be covered. We give you the exact timing already at the quote stage, so you can plan for the vehicle being off the road with no surprises.

faq.domanda: Is partial or full graphics better for my business?
faq.risposta: It depends on your goals. For tradespeople and shops, partial graphics with a clearly legible logo, contact details and service are often enough. Those wanting maximum impact go for a full wrap. During the design stage we recommend the solution best suited to your budget.

faq.domanda: Can I see a preview before printing?
faq.risposta: Yes. Before we print anything we send you a graphic mock-up of the design applied to your vehicle model, so you can approve every detail. The mock-up is usually available after a deposit has been paid.

faq.domanda: Does the vehicle need to be clean before application?
faq.risposta: Yes, the bodywork must be clean and free of waxes or residue that could affect how well the films adhere. If the vehicle arrives dirty we can take care of it, with a cleaning charge added to the invoice.

faq.domanda: What kinds of vehicles do you wrap?
faq.risposta: We wrap any vehicle: vans and company cars, private cars, trucks, buses and commercial vehicles of every size. From the small city car to the heavy goods vehicle, we adapt the project to the bodywork.

faq.domanda: Can the film be removed without damaging the bodywork?
faq.risposta: Yes. Professional films can be removed without damaging the original paintwork, and in the meantime they protect it from scratches and sun. This is especially handy for leased or rental vehicles, which have to be returned in perfect condition.
